subject: Joint agenda & MVP validation plan for Opsly pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@opsly.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Joint agenda & MVP validation plan for Opsly pilot

Alex — great to meet yesterday. Following up with a first draft of a short, actionable joint agenda (MAP) and an MVP validation timeline so we can align stakeholders and get a pilot running fast.

Link: opsly_map_template_v1.gdoc (preview) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOpslyMAP
Attachments: pilot-scope-slide-deck.pdf (slide highlights, 6 slides)

High-level ask: can you confirm the internal owners and whether a 45-day pilot is workable? I captured suggested milestones below:
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment access (app creds & sample data)
- Week 1–2: Integration + smoke tests (demo end-to-end)
- Week 3–4: Quality validation (prompt sets + acceptance criteria)
- Week 5: Security & data handling sign-off (CISO review)
- Week 6–7: Final acceptance & rollout plan

Next steps I propose:
1) You add any Opsly-specific milestones in the GDoc by EOD Wednesday
2) We schedule a 30-min kickoff (stakeholders only) for next week

If it helps, I can add a security milestone row and column for artifacts (SOC2 summary, retention policy).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@opsly.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@opsly.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T13:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint agenda & MVP validation plan for Opsly pilot

Thanks Marcus — this looks like a good start. I invited Priya (our CISO) so she can weigh in on the security milestone. Two quick notes from my side:

- 45 days is acceptable but we need an explicit security review window before acceptance. Can we add a dedicated week for a policy review + any Q&A with our security team?
- Opsly will need a short acceptance checklist so our product team can validate the model outputs against our false-positive tolerance. I can upload the checklist to the doc once we have the integration details.

I added a comment on the GDoc about data retention — Priya, feel free to jump in.

Best,
Alex
Senior Product Manager, Opsly
alex.kim@opsly.com

Marcus — copied Marissa for SOC2/evidence coordination. I reviewed the MAP and made three suggested edits in the doc:

1) Added a "Security artifacts" row with owner column (Marissa) and due dates. Example artifacts: SOC2 letter (summary), data retention matrix, encryption-at-rest confirmation.
2) Added an explicit 5-business-day window for the Opsly security review (Week 5) and a contingency for extended review (escalation path to AEs + Solutions).
3) Created an "Acceptance criteria" checklist section with sample thresholds for precision/recall and a comment thread for Opsly to paste their product checklist.

Marissa — can you drop the SOC2 summary and a one-page retention policy into the shared folder by Thursday? I put placeholder filenames in the attachments row.

Also suggest we propose a kickoff on Tuesday 9/29 at 10am PT. If that works I’ll send the invite and include the technical leads and Priya.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
